name: PasteNotch
tagline: A clipboard manager that lives in the notch, keeping every clip searchable and one shortcut away.
description:
PasteNotch is a clipboard manager for Mac that lives in the notch. It keeps a history of what you copy so you can carry on working and find an earlier clip later, either from the notch or with the ⇧⌘V shortcut.

It works on Macs with or without a notch.

## Features

- Keep an unlimited clipboard history of text, links, images, and files.
- Find earlier clips with search and filters.
- Organise clips with pins and Pages.
- Open the history from the notch or with ⇧⌘V.
- Sync clipboard history through iCloud.

## Where it fits

PasteNotch fits people who want a clipboard history that opens from the notch area of the screen rather than from a menu bar icon or a separate window. It is a one-time purchase rather than a subscription.

## Privacy and requirements

PasteNotch requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later and works on Macs with or without a notch. History sync uses iCloud. The 14-day free trial does not require an account.

## Pricing

PasteNotch is a one-time purchase of $4.99 with a 14-day free trial and a full refund within 14 days. An optional PasteNotch Cloud subscription is also available.
